description: Suggest covered European cities that fit a traveler's interests or favourite historical periods, e.g. "best cities for Byzantine history" or "a city break for art and food in Spain". Ranks cities by how many of their sights match, and says why.

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

trip_days.description: Days available; cities with far more or far fewer sights rank lower.
